title: Herbalife to Participate in 1 on 1 Meetings at Maxim Growth Summit on October 14

# Herbalife to Participate in 1 on 1 Meetings at Maxim Growth Summit on October 14


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_0263b67ad0dbb788d70ea4c26f2210fd/herbalife/news/2026-10-05_Herbalife_to_Participate_in_1_on_1_Meetings_at_959.pdf) Oct 5, 2026 • 7:05 am ET


LOS ANGELES--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Herbalife Ltd. (NYSE: HLF), a premier health and wellness company, community and platform, today announced Scott Schaefer, SVP of Finance and Transformation and incoming CFO, will participate in one on one meetings at the Maxim Growth Summit in New York on Wednesday, October 14, 2026.


For more information about the Maxim Growth Summit 2026:[https://maximgrp.com/2026-growth-summit](https://maximgrp.com/2026-growth-summit)


**About Herbalife Ltd.**


Herbalife (NYSE: HLF) is a premier health and wellness company, community and platform that has been changing people's lives with great nutrition products and a business opportunity for its independent distributors since 1980. The Company offers science-backed products to consumers in more than 90 markets through entrepreneurial distributors who provide one-on-one coaching and a supportive community that inspires their customers to embrace a healthier, more active lifestyle to live their best life.


For more information, visit[https://ir.herbalife.com](https://ir.herbalife.com/) .
